name: punchwall-map-progression
description: Validate spawn placement, progression gates, and key interaction affordances.

args.code:
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local player = game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()[1]
assert(player, "missing player")
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
assert(root, "missing character root")
local target=workspace.PunchWallRPG.Interactables['Depth Course Entrance'] local distance = (root.Position - target.Position).Magnitude
return HttpService:JSONEncode({ hasCharacter = true, spawnPlaced=character:GetAttribute("PunchWallSpawnPlaced")==true, canonicalRespawn=player.RespawnLocation==workspace.PunchWallRPG["Punch Rookie Spawn"], facingCourse=root.CFrame.LookVector.Z<-.9, spawnNearFirstWall = distance <= 18, spawnDistance = math.floor(distance + 0.5), mapExists = workspace:FindFirstChild("PunchWallRPG") ~= nil })

steps.label: punch-first spawn is within the first wall approach

args.code: local H=game.HttpService local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local a=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation local old=p.Character a:Invoke('Respawn') local deadline=os.clock()+6 repeat task.wait(.1) until (p.Character~=old and p.Character and p.Character:GetAttribute('PunchWallSpawnPlaced'))or os.clock()>deadline local c=p.Character local r=c and c:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') local entrance=workspace.PunchWallRPG.Interactables['Depth Course Entrance'] assert(r and c~=old and c:GetAttribute('PunchWallSpawnPlaced'),'new character not placed') task.wait(.4) local distance=(r.Position-entrance.Position).Magnitude local facing=r.CFrame.LookVector.Z<-.9 local target=r.Position+Vector3.new(3,0,0) r.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(target,target+Vector3.new(0,0,-1)) task.wait(.6) local noRepeatedTeleport=math.abs(r.Position.X-target.X)<.5 return H:JSONEncode({respawnContractValid=distance<=18 and facing and noRepeatedTeleport and p.RespawnLocation==workspace.PunchWallRPG['Punch Rookie Spawn'],distance=distance,facing=facing,noRepeatedTeleport=noRepeatedTeleport})

steps.label: normal respawn approaches course once without repeated relocation

args.code:
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local command = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):WaitForChild("PunchWallAutomation", 5)
assert(command, "missing PunchWallAutomation")
command:Invoke("Reset")
return HttpService:JSONEncode(command:Invoke("HitWall", "Concrete Wall"))

steps.label: fresh player blocked by concrete gate

args.code: local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local world=workspace.PunchWallRPG local tier,config for i,v in ipairs(G.Walls)do if v.name=='Cyber Gate'then tier=i config=v break end end assert(config and config.level==48,'canonical Cyber Gate configuration changed') local layer=(tier-1)*G.DepthWall.LayersPerTier+1 local block=world['Depth Blocks']:FindFirstChild(('DepthBlock_L%03d_C06_R02'):format(layer)) local landmark for _,v in ipairs(world['Depth Tier Landmarks']:GetChildren())do if v:GetAttribute('MaterialTier')==tier then landmark=v break end end local sign=landmark and landmark:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('SurfaceGui',true) local r=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation:Invoke('HitWall','Cyber Gate') return game.HttpService:JSONEncode({gateContractValid=block~=nil and block:GetAttribute('RequiredLevel')==48 and block:GetAttribute('HP')==config.hp and landmark~=nil and sign~=nil and r.ok==false and r.reason=='level_gate' and r.requiredLevel==48,requiredLevel=block and block:GetAttribute('RequiredLevel'),landmark=landmark and landmark.Name,sign=sign~=nil,result=r})

steps.label: high-tier connected block preserves actual level gate and visible landmark

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG local merchant=root.Interactables['Hero Armory Merchant Interaction'] local click=merchant and merchant:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('ClickDetector') local visible=root:FindFirstChild('Hero Armory Merchant NPC',true) or root:FindFirstChild('Hero Armory Merchant NPC Fallback',true) return H:JSONEncode({merchantPresent=merchant~=nil,click=click~=nil and click.MaxActivationDistance>0,visibleLandmark=visible~=nil})

steps.label: current armory merchant has an actionable visible landmark
